principles: 2026 H1 is development data from this point forward; it must never again be described as OOS for V3.
Do not search new thresholds before failure decomposition is complete.
Separate entrance stability, ordering/formation stability, and payout sufficiency.
Do not accept a strategy merely because pooled 4-period ROI exceeds 100%.
Prefer simple rules, broad threshold plateaus, adequate race counts, and low single-hit payout dependence.
Reserve 2026-07-01 onward as untouched forward OOS until V3 is frozen.

metrics: candidate entrance count and entrance rate
exact frozen formation hit count and hit rate
top role-triplet frequencies among candidate races
average and median payout on formation hits
stake per race and break-even hit-rate/payout relationship

phase2_condition_complexity.thresholds: coarse fixed grids only; no fine tuning around observed optima
phase2_condition_complexity.required_period_profitability: evaluate each period separately; pooled profitability alone is insufficient
phase2_condition_complexity.minimum_sample_policy: favor candidates with meaningful counts in every period; sparse candidates require explicit penalty
